question: Why did the error rate go up on 20 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: New deployment of catalog v4.20 to us-east caused the error rate to rise.
why_chain: Deployed catalog v4.20 to us-east (record R014) before the error rate spike.
The error rate for service checkout in region eu-west increased from 0.53% to 1.14% (evidence E1).
The deployment to us-east occurred 1 min before the change point (evidence E1).

contributing_factors.description: Routine release of checkout v3.20 to ap-south did not affect the error rate.
why_chain: Checkout v3.20 to ap-south was a routine release (record R012).
The error rate for service checkout in region eu-west increased from 0.53% to 1.14% (evidence E1).
Routine releases to ap-south did not cause the error rate to spike (evidence E7).

ruled_out.hypothesis: Customer typo on the help page caused the error rate to rise.
ruled_out.reason: Customer reports a typo on the help page (record R013) 91 minutes before the change.

ruled_out.hypothesis: Customer request for invoice download caused the error rate to rise.
ruled_out.reason: Customer asks how to download an invoice (record R011) 340 minutes before the change.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service checkout in region eu-west rose from 0.53% to 1.14% (+115%), with a change point at 2026-03-20T09:35:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service checkout in region eu-west: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.12).
At the same time, request volume for service checkout in region eu-west stayed about the same (280 per 5 min before, 348 per 5 min after, +25%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service checkout in region eu-west stayed about the same (222 ms before, 223 ms after, +0%).
Deployed catalog v4.20 to us-east (catalog, us-east; 1 min before the change; record R014)
Customer reports a typo on the help page. (catalog, us-east; 91 min before the change; record R013)
Deployed checkout v3.20 to ap-south (routine release) (checkout, ap-south; 278 min before the change; record R012)
Customer asks how to download an invoice. (auth, us-east; 340 min before the change; record R011)

reasons: ✓ A change event (deploys) lines up in time (1 min before the change).
✗ It concerns a different service/region than the one that changed.
✗ No logs or alerts from the affected segment confirm the problem.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.
missing_data: Change records for the affected service/region
Error logs or traces from the affected segment after the change

actions.action: Roll back the catalog v4.20 deployment to us-east.
Monitor for similar error spikes in the future and take quick action if they occur.
Review and test the new catalog v4.20 in a staging environment before production deployment.
